page.notes: The first Hebrew and Greek-like forms in the top list (אַח, הֵאָח, אֲבוֹי) and the Hebrew vowel points in the conjunction list are reconstructed from a small scan and may not match the printed pointing exactly; check them. The swash symbol after "&" in "etiam" is uncertain and may be an abbreviation mark rather than an ampersand. The question mark forms in "Syntaxis?" and "construendis?" are printed as a reversed-style mark and are copied as "?". The paragraph beginning "Substantivum" ends with a printed hyphen and continues on the next page. The horizontal rules are not transcribed as text.
